reason: Retain the measured 59-member shared confinement package: it owns one cross-platform request, capability floor, launch report and action-broker contract. The added admission.go separates required confinement from observed availability, preserving explicit host execution and refusing unavailable required boundaries; it is a real authority decision boundary. Platform enforcement and the sealed file-mask lifecycle remain private in linuxsandbox. Further movement solely for count would fragment the shared contract or add forwarding APIs. Focused admission, capability and applied file-mask controls protect these boundaries; reconsider further membership growth.
